blinded_reassessment.analysis_requirement: retain the initial-wave analysis and report final results with the achieved replicate count and pooled reassessment inputs
blinded_reassessment.decision_rule: select the smallest prespecified replicate option whose worst-case recalculated MDE is at or below maximum_desired_mde; otherwise retain the maximum option and report the residual limitation
blinded_reassessment.estimator: pooled within-scenario replicate correlation and binary-outcome variance across the full core cohort
blinded_reassessment.timing: after the initial three-replicate confirmatory wave and before model labels or comparative outcomes are unblinded

interpretation: These are sensitivity assumptions, not empirical estimates. The report must be regenerated after the canary and again after human pilot data become available.
